input_domain: a string of 0 to 11 characters, each character any byte except NUL, given as the bytes b0 to b10 up to the first NUL byte; parse_add_padding is called when the string is one or more decimal digits
limitations: parse_uint32, parse_uint64 and parse_add_padding; parse_block_number, which the proposed change also edits to call parse_uint32, uses strdup, free and strchr and is not examined; strings of up to 11 characters, so 11 digits reach 99999999999 and no string reaches the 64-bit limit; parse_add_padding only for strings of decimal digits, not for white space, signs or text, which strtoul accepts or reads as 0; the model reads strlen, strspn, strtoul and strtoull as the stand-ins in the prelude: base 10, the accept set 0123456789 and a string without white space or sign at its start, anything else fails a property of the stand-in; the replay of a counterexample calls the C library; the integer types, the notice, the assert macro, the constant FLAC__STREAM_METADATA_LENGTH_LEN and the prototypes are not extracted by the gate but copied into the prelude from include/FLAC/ordinals.h, include/FLAC/assert.h, src/libFLAC/format.c and src/metaflac/options.c at the same revision; FLAC__ASSERT is the C library assert; parse_uint64 is listed for both variants but only the fixed parse_uint32 calls it; the unwinding bound is 12
